import asyncio

from seed import AsyncSeedPhpGlobalHeaderEnv

client = AsyncSeedPhpGlobalHeaderEnv(
    version="YOUR_VERSION",
    base_url="https://yourhost.com/path/to/api",
)


async def main() -> None:
    await client.service.get_with_api_version()


asyncio.run(main())
